finding.actual: A forged but self-hashed AcceptanceReceipt with subject_ref naming a different existing Qualification is accepted; upgrading the contaminated fixture publishes a target with RESTORED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
finding.expected: Bind the receipt subject to the actual historical DRAFT revision of the same Qualification, plus the existing result evidence and independence conditions.
finding.threat_boundary: Contaminated SQLite input with legitimate schema and valid JSON contracts; not an HTTP/API authorization bypass.

additional_findings.actual: A native NTFS directory junction to the source directory is returned unchanged by filepath.EvalSymlinks in this environment; a new snapshot child below that junction passes path overlap checks. Upgrade succeeds and writes its manifest physically inside the source directory.
additional_findings.expected: Resolve native directory junctions or compare final ancestor directory identities before accepting four separate directories.
